description: Welcome to NCD Team! 🚀 We are looking for passionate members to solve space and Earth challenges. I bring a strong analytical and research mindset from the Biology Olympiad. We are looking for creative thinkers, researchers, and earth science enthusiasts to help us find Earth analogs for Moon and Mars bases. Join us!
summary: "Our project identifies the Atacama Desert in Chile as a prime terrestrial analog for Mars. Due to its extreme aridity, high UV radiation, and volcanic soil, it closely mimics Martian surface conditions. We compared these environments to show why Atacama is perfect for testing rovers, spacesuits, and life-detection instruments before actual space missions. Identifying such analogs is crucial for the success and safety of future planetary exploration
details: We researched the Atacama Desert's geological and climatic features. We compared its extreme aridity and soil composition to Mars, highlighting its importance as a terrestrial analog for testing rovers and future space missions
